questions.question: Dr. Amrani must manage his corporate income tax (CIT) declaration. According to Moroccan tax legislation, what is the normal CIT rate for companies?
questions.explanation: Dr. Bennani explains: 'The normal CIT rate in Morocco is 25% for companies.' Dr. Amrani: 'I will plan for this rate in my forecasts.'

questions.question: Dr. Bennani, practicing as a sole proprietor, is subject to personal income tax (PIT). According to the Moroccan progressive scale, what is the minimum taxable bracket?
questions.explanation: Dr. Amrani explains: 'The minimum PIT bracket is 0% up to 30,000 DH. It's an exemption for the lowest incomes.' Dr. Bennani: 'I will check the scale.'

questions.question: Dr. Amrani must account for VAT on his services. According to Moroccan legislation, what is the normal VAT rate applicable to dental care?
questions.explanation: Dr. Bennani explains: 'Dental care is subject to a reduced VAT rate of 7% in Morocco.' Dr. Amrani: 'I will apply this rate on my invoices.'

questions.question: Dr. Bennani must declare her professional income. According to tax legislation, what is the annual income declaration deadline?
questions.explanation: Dr. Amrani explains: 'The annual income declaration must be filed by April 30.' Dr. Bennani: 'I will respect this deadline.'

questions.question: Dr. Amrani wishes to depreciate the acquisition of a new dental chair. According to tax legislation, what is the commonly accepted depreciation period?
questions.explanation: Dr. Bennani explains: 'A dental chair is generally depreciated over 5 years, in accordance with tax practices.' Dr. Amrani: 'I will apply this period.'

questions.question: Dr. Bennani must manage a tax audit of her practice. According to taxpayer rights, what is the statute of limitations for taxes?
questions.explanation: Dr. Amrani explains: 'The statute of limitations for taxes is generally 5 years.' Dr. Bennani: 'I will keep my documents for at least 5 years.'

questions.question: Dr. Amrani must manage the taxation of capital gains on the sale of his practice. According to legislation, what is the rate applicable to professional capital gains?
questions.explanation: Dr. Bennani explains: 'The rate applicable to professional capital gains is 25%.' Dr. Amrani: 'I will take this rate into account in my calculations.'

questions.question: Dr. Bennani must manage her practice's deductible expenses. According to legislation, what type of expenses is tax-deductible?
options: Professional expenses related to the activity
questions.explanation: Dr. Amrani explains: 'Only professional expenses related to the practice's activity are deductible.' Dr. Bennani: 'I will ensure I separate my personal and professional expenses.'

questions.question: Dr. Amrani must manage the payment of professional tax. According to Moroccan legislation, what is the basis of this tax?
questions.explanation: Dr. Bennani explains: 'Professional tax is based on the rental value of professional premises.' Dr. Amrani: 'I will check my rental value.'

questions.question: Dr. Bennani wishes to optimize her tax situation using tax relief schemes. According to legislation, which scheme is accessible to liberal professions?
options: Creation of a real estate company for professional premises
questions.explanation: Dr. Amrani explains: 'The creation of a real estate company for professional premises allows optimization of the practice's property taxation.' Dr. Bennani: 'I will study this option.'

questions.question: Dr. Amrani must manage his practice's social security contributions. According to legislation, what is the CNSS contribution rate for employees?
questions.explanation: Dr. Bennani explains: 'The CNSS contribution rate for employees is 6.48%.' Dr. Amrani: 'I will apply this rate to salaries.'

questions.question: Dr. Bennani must manage her staff salary declarations. According to legislation, what is the monthly salary declaration deadline to CNSS?
options: The last day of the following month
questions.explanation: Dr. Amrani explains: 'Salary declarations to CNSS must be made by the last day of the following month.' Dr. Bennani: 'I will respect this deadline.'

questions.question: Dr. Amrani wishes to invest in new management software. According to legislation, how are software programs treated for tax purposes?
options: They are fully deductible in the year of purchase
questions.explanation: Dr. Bennani explains: 'Software is generally depreciated over 3 years.' Dr. Amrani: 'I will plan for this depreciation.'

questions.question: Dr. Bennani must manage the transfer of her practice to a successor. According to legislation, what is the tax regime applicable to the transfer?
questions.explanation: Dr. Amrani explains: 'The transfer of a practice is subject to registration duties.' Dr. Bennani: 'I will find out about the amount of the duties.'

questions.question: Dr. Amrani must manage a tax audit. According to taxpayer rights, may he challenge a decision of the tax authorities?
options: Yes, he may file an administrative appeal followed by a court appeal
Yes, but only through judicial channels
No, he must accept the decision
questions.explanation: Dr. Bennani explains: 'The taxpayer may challenge a tax decision through an administrative appeal and then through legal channels.' Dr. Amrani: 'I will find out about appeal procedures.'

questions.question: Dr. Bennani wishes to optimize the legal structure of her practice. According to legislation, which legal form offers the best asset protection?
questions.explanation: Dr. Amrani explains: 'The LLC offers asset protection by limiting the shareholder's liability to their contributions.' Dr. Bennani: 'I will consider creating an LLC.'

questions.question: Dr. Amrani must manage his practice's social charges. According to legislation, what is the employer CNSS contribution rate?
questions.explanation: Dr. Bennani explains: 'The employer CNSS contribution rate is 8.98%.' Dr. Amrani: 'I will plan for this rate in my budget.'

questions.question: Dr. Bennani must manage VAT on prosthetic services. According to legislation, what is the VAT rate applicable to dental prosthetics?
questions.explanation: Dr. Amrani explains: 'Dental prosthetics are subject to the reduced VAT rate of 7%.' Dr. Bennani: 'I will apply this rate on my prosthetic invoices.'

questions.question: Dr. Amrani wishes to invest in new medical equipment. According to legislation, are there tax advantages for this type of investment?
options: Yes, VAT is recoverable on new equipment
questions.explanation: Dr. Bennani explains: 'VAT on new equipment is recoverable, which represents a significant tax advantage.' Dr. Amrani: 'I will take advantage of this benefit.'

questions.question: Dr. Bennani must manage her practice's VAT declaration. According to legislation, what is the monthly VAT declaration deadline?
options: The last day of the following month
questions.explanation: Dr. Amrani explains: 'The monthly VAT declaration must be filed by the 20th of the following month.' Dr. Bennani: 'I will respect this deadline.'

questions.question: Dr. Amrani must manage the tax situation of his partners. According to legislation, what is the tax regime applicable to LLC partners?
options: They are taxed on the company's profits
They are taxed on capital gains
questions.explanation: Dr. Bennani explains: 'LLC partners are taxed on the dividends they receive.' Dr. Amrani: 'I will plan for this taxation.'

questions.question: Dr. Bennani wishes to anticipate her retirement taxation. According to legislation, which scheme allows for advantageous retirement savings?
questions.explanation: Dr. Amrani explains: 'The Moroccan Retirement Savings Plan allows you to build retirement savings with tax advantages.' Dr. Bennani: 'I will look into it.'

questions.question: Dr. Amrani must manage the taxation of reinvested profits. According to legislation, is there a tax advantage for reinvested profits?
options: No, profits are taxed regardless of their use
Yes, reinvested profits benefit from a reduction
questions.explanation: Dr. Bennani explains: 'Reinvested profits in the company may benefit from a tax reduction.' Dr. Amrani: 'I will study the terms of this reduction.'

questions.question: Dr. Bennani must manage the transfer of her practice to her children. According to legislation, what is the tax regime applicable to this transfer?
questions.explanation: Dr. Amrani explains: 'Transfer to a descendant is subject to inheritance duties.' Dr. Bennani: 'I will find out about possible exemptions.'

questions.question: Dr. Amrani, after optimizing his practice's taxation, receives congratulations from Dr. Bennani. What is the next step for Dr. Amrani?
options: Share his tax expertise with young practitioners
questions.explanation: Dr. Bennani explains: 'Sharing your tax expertise is the next step. You can train young practitioners in practice management.' Dr. Amrani: 'I will share my experience.'
